meta_description: Elite Landscapers Liverpool. Expert garden design, landscaping, and maintenance across Merseyside. Free quotes, same-day response. Call 07984 594712.
hero_eyebrow: Professional Garden Design — Fully Insured & Local
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to show-stopping gardens. We design and build landscapes that work for your home and your lifestyle.
services_heading: Complete Landscaping Services Across Liverpool & Merseyside
services_subhead: We handle every aspect of garden transformation, from initial design through to ongoing maintenance and seasonal care.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke garden designs tailored to your space, style, and budget. We take your ideas and create a practical, beautiful plan before any work begins.

services.title: Patio & Hardscaping
services.desc: Professional installation of patios, decking, pathways, and boundary features. Built to last with quality materials and expert craftsmanship.

services.title: Planting & Borders
services.desc: Vibrant planting schemes designed for colour, texture, and seasonal interest. We source healthy plants and establish them properly for lasting growth.

services.title: Lawn Care & Grass Works
services.desc: From new lawn installation and levelling to feeding, scarification, and aeration. We keep your grass healthy, thick, and green year-round.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular pruning, hedge trimming, weeding, and seasonal tidying. Flexible monthly or quarterly visits keep your garden looking cared-for without the effort.

services.title: Water Features & Drainage
services.desc: Expert installation of ponds, water features, and sustainable drainage solutions. We combine functionality with visual impact.

about_pullquote: I started Elite because gardens shouldn't be a luxury—they should be enjoyable.
about_para_1: Elite Landscapers was founded on the belief that every garden deserves proper design and care. Over 12 years, we've transformed hundreds of outdoor spaces across Liverpool and Merseyside—from small urban yards to sprawling country gardens. We invest time in understanding what our clients want, then deliver results that exceed expectations.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is our commitment to listening. We don't impose a 'signature style'—we create gardens that fit your home, your family, and your lifestyle. Our clients return year after year for maintenance because they know we care for their gardens like we do our own.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Homeowners Say About Elite Landscapers

reviews.text: We had no idea what to do with our back garden—it was just overgrown grass and a broken fence. The team came round, listened to what we wanted, and produced a design we absolutely loved. Three months later it's finished and looks amazing. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Had Elite in for regular maintenance every month for the past year. Garden looks brilliant and they're reliable, tidy, and fair with pricing. They spotted a drainage issue before it became a nightmare—that alone saved us a fortune. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David H.

reviews.text: Fantastic crew. Took down two old trees, levelled the lawn, and built a new patio in two weeks. Professional, clean, and they even cleared up properly at the end. It's rare to find tradespeople who treat your home with that level of respect.
reviews.author: Sarah K.
